title.sl: was built, is made of · Trpnik
title.de: was built, is made of · Das Passiv
title.it: was built, is made of · Il passivo
title.en: was built, is made of · The passive

description.sl: Ko je pomembno, kaj se zgodi, ne kdo: be + deležnik. The bridge was built in 1720, ne *was build*. Kdo: by Mr Dixon. Iz česa: is made of iron. Tudi: It was given to me.
description.de: Wenn wichtig ist, was geschieht, nicht wer: be + Partizip. The bridge was built in 1720, nicht *was build*. Wer: by Mr Dixon. Woraus: is made of iron. Auch: It was given to me.
description.it: Quando conta ciò che succede, non chi lo fa: be + participio. The bridge was built in 1720, non *was build*. Chi: by Mr Dixon. Di che cosa: is made of iron. Anche: It was given to me.
description.en: When what happens matters more than who does it: be + the participle. The bridge was built in 1720. Who: by Mr Dixon. What it's made of: is made of iron. Also: It was given to me.

review: en, sl, de, it: machine-written (Claude), not reviewed by a native speaker

story.sl: Mr Dixon shows you round the smithy. Every horseshoe here is still made by hand. · Mr Dixon ti razkaže kovačnico. Vsaka podkev je tu še vedno narejena ročno.
story.de: Mr Dixon shows you round the smithy. Every horseshoe here is still made by hand. · Mr Dixon zeigt dir die Schmiede. Jedes Hufeisen wird hier noch von Hand gemacht.
story.it: Mr Dixon shows you round the smithy. Every horseshoe here is still made by hand. · Mr Dixon ti fa vedere la fucina. Qui ogni ferro di cavallo è ancora fatto a mano.
story.en: Mr Dixon shows you round the smithy. Every horseshoe here is still made by hand.

instruction.sl: Pick the right form · Izberi pravilno obliko
instruction.de: Pick the right form · Wähle die richtige Form
instruction.it: Pick the right form · Scegli la forma giusta

explain.sl:
**Trpnik: be + deležnik. build, built, built: deležnik je built**
- **The bridge was built in 1720.** · Most so zgradili leta 1720.
explain.de:
**Passiv: be + Partizip. build, built, built: das Partizip ist built**
- **The bridge was built in 1720.** · Die Brücke wurde 1720 gebaut.
explain.it:
**Passivo: be + participio. build, built, built: il participio è built**
- **The bridge was built in 1720.** · Il ponte è stato costruito nel 1720.
explain.en:
**The passive: be + the participle. build, built, built: the participle is built**
- **The bridge was built in 1720.**

instruction.it: Pick the right word · Scegli la parola giusta

explain.sl:
**Iz česa je: made of (tudi made from). Kdo ga je naredil: by**
- **It's made of iron.** · Iz železa je.
- **It was made by Mr Dixon.** · Naredil ga je Mr Dixon.
explain.de:
**Woraus: made of (auch made from). Wer: by**
- **It's made of iron.** · Es ist aus Eisen.
- **It was made by Mr Dixon.** · Mr Dixon hat es gemacht.
explain.it:
**Di che cosa: made of (anche made from). Chi: by**
- **It's made of iron.** · È di ferro.
- **It was made by Mr Dixon.** · L'ha fatto Mr Dixon.
explain.en:
**What it's made of: made of (also made from). Who made it: by**
- **It's made of iron.**
- **It was made by Mr Dixon.**

explain.de:

- **It was mended by Mr Dixon.** · Es wurde von Mr Dixon repariert.
explain.it:
**Chi l'ha fatto: by, non from o of come da, di**
- **It was mended by Mr Dixon.** · È stato riparato da Mr Dixon.
explain.en:

instruction.sl: Which are right? · Katere so pravilne?
instruction.de: Which are right? · Welche sind richtig?
instruction.it: Which are right? · Quali sono giuste?

options: Eggs are sold at the farm.
The gate can opened from inside.

explain.sl:
**Vedno be + deležnik: was built, are sold, can be opened. Vprašanje z be, brez did**
- **Was the letter sent?** · So pismo poslali?
- **The gate can be opened from inside.** · Vrata se dajo odpreti od znotraj.
explain.de:
**Immer be + Partizip: was built, are sold, can be opened. Die Frage mit be, ohne did**
- **Was the letter sent?** · Wurde der Brief geschickt?
- **The gate can be opened from inside.** · Das Tor kann von innen geöffnet werden.
explain.it:
**Sempre be + participio: was built, are sold, can be opened. La domanda con be, senza did**
- **Was the letter sent?** · La lettera è stata spedita?
- **The gate can be opened from inside.** · Il cancello si può aprire da dentro.
explain.en:
**Always be + the participle: was built, are sold, can be opened. Questions with be, no did**
- **Was the letter sent?**
- **The gate can be opened from inside.**

instruction.sl: Fill the gap · Dopolni: Vsako jutro kruh za gostilno speče Granny Maggie.
instruction.de: Fill the gap · Ergänze: Jeden Morgen wird das Brot für das Gasthaus von Granny Maggie gebacken.
instruction.it: Fill the gap · Completa: Ogni mattina il pane per la locanda viene sfornato da Granny Maggie.
instruction.en: Fill the gap: Every morning the bread for the inn is baked by Granny Maggie.

exercises.text: Every morning the bread for the inn ___ (bake) by Granny Maggie.

hint.sl: Vsako jutro: sedanjik. Kruh se ne speče sam.
hint.de: Jeden Morgen: Gegenwart. Das Brot backt sich nicht selbst.
hint.it: Ogni mattina: presente. Il pane non si cuoce da solo.
hint.en: Every morning: the present. The bread doesn't bake itself.

explain.sl:
**Kar se vedno dogaja: is, are + deležnik**
- **The bread is baked here.** · Tu pečejo kruh.
explain.de:
**Was immer geschieht: is, are + Partizip**
- **The bread is baked here.** · Das Brot wird hier gebacken.
explain.it:
**Ciò che succede sempre: is, are + participio**
- **The bread is baked here.** · Il pane si fa qui.
explain.en:
**What always happens: is, are + the participle**
- **The bread is baked here.**

instruction.sl: Fill the gap · Dopolni: Samu so sinoči ukradli kombi.
instruction.de: Fill the gap · Ergänze: Sams Lieferwagen wurde letzte Nacht gestohlen.
instruction.it: Fill the gap · Completa: Ieri notte hanno rubato il furgone di Sam.
instruction.en: Fill the gap: Sam's van was stolen last night.

hint.de: Vergangenheit; der Dieb ist nicht wichtig.
hint.en: The past; the thief doesn't matter.

explain.sl:
**Preteklost: was, were + deležnik (steal, stole, stolen). V pogovoru tudi got stolen**
- **Sam's van was stolen.** · Samu so ukradli kombi.
explain.de:
**Vergangenheit: was, were + Partizip (steal, stole, stolen). Gesprochen auch got stolen**
- **Sam's van was stolen.** · Sams Lieferwagen wurde gestohlen.
explain.it:
**Passato: was, were + participio (steal, stole, stolen). A voce anche got stolen**
- **Sam's van was stolen.** · Hanno rubato il furgone di Sam.
explain.en:
**The past: was, were + the participle (steal, stole, stolen). In talk also got stolen**
- **Sam's van was stolen.**

hint.sl: Vprašanje v trpniku: z be, ne z did.
hint.de: Frage im Passiv: mit be, nicht mit did.

explain.sl:
**V trpniku vpraša be: brez did**
- **When was the church built?** · Kdaj so zgradili cerkev?
explain.de:
**Im Passiv fragt be: kein did**
- **When was the church built?** · Wann wurde die Kirche gebaut?
explain.it:
**Al passivo chiede be: niente did**
- **When was the church built?** · Quando è stata costruita la chiesa?
explain.en:
**In the passive be asks: no did**
- **When was the church built?**

hint.sl: give, gave, given: kateri je deležnik?
hint.de: give, gave, given: Welches ist das Partizip?

explain.sl:
**Trpnik s komu: was given to me (deležnik given)**
- **It was given to me.** · Dali so mi ga.
explain.de:
**Passiv mit wem: was given to me (Partizip given)**
- **It was given to me.** · Man hat es mir gegeben.
explain.it:
**Passivo con a chi: was given to me (participio given)**
- **It was given to me.** · Mi è stato dato.
explain.en:
**The passive with to whom: was given to me (the participle given)**
- **It was given to me.**

prompt.sl: Vprašaj gospoda Dixona, kdaj so zgradili kovačnico.

accept: When was the smithy built, Mr Dixon?

explain.sl:
**Vprašanje v trpniku: When + was + osebek + deležnik**
- **When was the smithy built?** · Kdaj so zgradili kovačnico?
explain.de:
**Die Frage im Passiv: When + was + Subjekt + Partizip**
- **When was the smithy built?** · Wann wurde die Schmiede gebaut?
explain.it:
**La domanda al passivo: When + was + soggetto + participio**
- **When was the smithy built?** · Quando è stata costruita la fucina?
explain.en:
**A passive question: When + was + the subject + the participle**
- **When was the smithy built?**
